title: DataMimic
summary: A full-stack TypeScript web app (Express API + React client) for uploading CSVs and generating synthetic datasets with privacy/utility evaluation, using a Python backend script or a JS fallback. The Python generator directly imports and runs SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, GaussianCopula, TVAE, CopulaGAN) with SingleTableMetadata and constraints, plus evaluate_quality/evaluate_privacy, making SDV the core synthesis engine.
evidence: python_scripts/generate_synthetic.py:21-36 imports CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, constraints, evaluate_quality
